page_title: VAL 1-1 SEV | Valencia v Sevilla 07/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The main referee, Guillermo Cuadra, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) is given a yellow card for dissent.
90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Pepelu (Valencia) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
90+5' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) picked up a yellow card from referee.
90+3' 1 - 1 Goal! Filip Ugrinic provides Hugo Duro (Valencia) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort under the bar. 1:1.

90+2' Great solo effort by Largie Ramazani (Valencia) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
90+1' Valencia are ruled offside.
90+1' Chance! Lucas Beltran (Valencia) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Diego Lopez, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Castrin (Sevilla) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
87' Sevilla seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
87' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Thierry Correia (Valencia) for a tough tackle.
86' Matias Almeyda prepares a substitution. Lucien Agoume is replaced by Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oso trots off the pitch and is replaced by Alfonso Gonzalez (Sevilla).

84' Lucas Beltran (Valencia) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Odysseas Vlachodimos, who pulls off a comfortable save!
82' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) attempts to discuss the decision with Guillermo Cuadra, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
81' Matias Almeyda has decided to make a change. Joan Jordan (Sevilla) replaces Peque.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) is coming onto the pitch as Jose Gaya cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Pepelu (Valencia) on the edge of the box.
76' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
75' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Cesar Azpilicueta (Sevilla).
74' The foul by Jose Copete (Valencia) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Guillermo Cuadra.
74' Lucas Beltran (Valencia) has a first-time shot at goal. It's a good effort from the edge of the box, but flies just a whisker past the left post.
73' Half-chance! Lucas Beltran (Valencia) plays a pass into the box, but Odysseas Vlachodimos reacts well to snuff out the attack.
70' Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight and sees a foul from Filip Ugrinic (Valencia).
68' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Largie Ramazani (Valencia) replacing Luis Rioja.

67' Peque (Sevilla) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
64' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) brings his opponent down. Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) for Andre Almeida.
63' Carlos Corberan has decided to substitute Arnaut Danjuma and he is replaced by Diego Lopez (Valencia).
63' Substitution. Javi Guerra is replaced by Lucas Beltran (Valencia).
62' Luis Rioja (Valencia) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
58' 0 - 1 This is definitely not what Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 0:1.
58' Thierry Correia (Valencia) brings an opponent down and Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game.
56' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valencia comes to nothing.
52' Foul! Castrin (Sevilla) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
49' Jose Copete (Valencia) is caught offside!
49' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) makes a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Flag up against Akor Adams (Sevilla). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
46' Referee Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' Valencia work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

42' Luis Rioja (Valencia) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball goes out for a corner. Valencia can continue in their attacking effort.
40' 1:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
36' Valencia couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Odysseas Vlachodimos (Sevilla) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
35' Cesar Azpilicueta (Sevilla) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
33' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
32' The ball is cleared after Akor Adams (Sevilla) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee blows his whistle, Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
31' Castrin (Sevilla) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Akor Adams (Sevilla) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
28' Matias Almeyda is stunned as referee Guillermo Cuadra shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
26' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle after Andre Almeida (Valencia) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
25' Odysseas Vlachodimos (Sevilla) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
25' Looks like Odysseas Vlachodimos (Sevilla) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
23' Guillermo Cuadra rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Peque (Sevilla).
22' The linesman signals that Akor Adams (Sevilla) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
18' Akor Adams (Sevilla) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
15' Guillermo Cuadra blows the whistle, Andre Almeida (Valencia) is penalised for a foul.
14' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
13' Thierry Correia (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
12' The cross into the penalty area from Peque (Sevilla) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
11' Sevilla players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
9' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
5' Sevilla have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

4' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Julen Agirrezabala dived superbly to block the header from around the penalty spot, which was aimed straight towards the bottom left corner by Peque (Sevilla). The referee points to the corner flag and Sevilla will take a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Valencia will take the kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
